async def t5():
    started = []
    async def job(i):
        started.append(i)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
    await run_tasks([lambda i=i: job(i) for i in range(6)], 2)
    assert started == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5], started
    print("5. ordering ok:", started)

    running = 0; peak = 0
    async def job():
        nonlocal running, peak
        running += 1; peak = max(peak, running)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        running -= 1
    await run_tasks([job] * 5, 1)
    assert peak == 1, peak
    print("6. serial ok, peak =", peak)
